up: Retrieve the first 1000 activity rows of type IC50 (standard_type = 'IC50') with exact measurements (standard_relation = '=') and non‑null pChEMBL values, for the human single‑protein target (target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN', organism = 'Homo sapiens') with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1741217 (DNA dC‑>dU‑editing enzyme APOBEC‑3G). For each row, output the following columns: assay ChEMBL ID (from assays.chembl_id), target type (from target_dictionary.target_type), tax_id (from target_dictionary.tax_id), canonical SMILES (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles), molecule ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), standard type (from activities.standard_type), and pChEMBL value (from activities.pchembl_value). Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID ascending, then by assay ChEMBL ID ascending. Limit the output to 1000 rows.
sql: SELECT ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, act.standard_type, act.pchembl_value FROM activities act JOIN assays ass ON act.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE act.standard_type = 'IC50' AND act.standard_relation = '=' AND act.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL AND td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1741217' AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' ORDER BY molecule_chembl_id, assay_chembl_id LIMIT 1000;
